children: Forward Industries completed a registered direct offering of 3,125,000 common shares at $8.00 per share, generating approximately $25 million in gross proceeds. The company entered a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor on September 22, 2026, and closed the financing on September 24, 2026. Proceeds will support the purchase of Solana, working capital, and general corporate purposes. In parallel, Forward appointed A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as exclusive placement agent, agreeing to a 5% fee on gross proceeds and reimbursement of up to $50,000 in legal expenses.
